statements.statement: Parsing and formatting run in a Web Worker in this browser tab; the tool does not upload your JSON; settings and eligible input are saved in local storage; 50 KB; 200,000 characters; Clear or Ctrl/⌘+L removes saved input; the page loads Google Analytics and AdSense; format and minify are recorded only after success and deduplicated; typing, restoration, invalid JSON, worker failures, cancellation and stale results are silent; events carry the tool name and action only.

statements.statement: JSON.parse stores numbers as 64-bit doubles; integers above 2^53 − 1 are not all storable; 1830000000000000001 becomes 1830000000000000000; JSON.stringify writes 1.0 as 1 and 1e2 as 100; this tool keeps the digits and lists numbers JavaScript would change.

python3 -m json.tool escapes every character outside printable ASCII by default; Kraków becomes Krak\u00f3w; --no-ensure-ascii since Python 3.9; this tool writes characters as they are; Escape non-ASCII gives ASCII-only output.
statements.qualification: 原句「ASCII 以外 / 非 ASCII」漏掉 DEL；Python 文档为 non-ASCII and non-printable，工具同样从 U+007F 起转义，已改。

statements.statement: Accept JSON5 / JSONC or use Convert to JSON; comments are removed and trailing commas, single quotes and unquoted keys rewritten; a note lists every kind of change; NaN and Infinity stay an error.
statements.qualification: engine:444-450 只在 j5 解析成功时给 json5 变更；NaN/Infinity 报 nonFinite（engine:312）。

statements.statement: Values stay the same; whitespace changes; string escapes are rewritten as JSON.stringify does (\u00e9 → é, \/ → /); numbers and duplicate keys are kept as written unless chosen otherwise.
statements.qualification: quote() 用 JSON.stringify；数值按 raw 输出；dupes 默认 keep。

statements.statement: Files up to 50 MB open; input up to 2 MB is formatted as you type, above that press Format; parsing runs in a Web Worker; editing, Format again or Clear stops the previous run; test 2026-10-03 (Apple M1 Max, Chromium 152): 10.7 MB took 2 to 4 seconds, putting the text into the input box took 1 to 2 seconds.

statements.statement: 解析与格式化在本标签页的 Web Worker 中执行，不上传；设置与符合条件的输入写入本地存储；单工具 50 KB（JSON 序列化后），超限保留旧状态；200,000 字符起只存设置；清空或 Ctrl/⌘+L 删除已存输入；本页加载 GA 与 AdSense；format / minify 仅在成功后记录并按「输入 + 选项」去重；键入、恢复、无效、失败、取消、过期结果不记录；事件只含工具名与动作。

statements.statement: 多数工具用 JSON.parse，数字存为 64 位双精度；超过 9007199254740991 的整数不一定存准，1845223349876512769 变成 1845223349876512800；JSON.stringify 把 1.0 写成 1、1e2 写成 100；本工具按原文保留并列出会变的数字。
python3 -m json.tool 默认把可打印 ASCII 以外的字符写成 \uXXXX，「张三」成为 \u5f20\u4e09；Python 3.9 起可加 --no-ensure-ascii；本工具默认原样输出，勾选「转义非 ASCII」得到纯 ASCII。

statements.statement: 解析と整形はこのタブの Web Worker で行い、JSON をアップロードしない；設定と条件に合う入力をローカルストレージに保存；ツールごとに JSON 化後 50 KB、超えると前の状態が残る；200,000 文字以上は設定だけ保存；クリアか Ctrl/⌘+L で保存入力を削除；GA と AdSense を読み込む；format / minify は成功後だけ記録し重複しない；入力途中・復元・不正・失敗・中止・古い結果は記録しない；イベントはツール名と操作名のみ。

python3 -m json.tool は既定で表示可能な ASCII 以外を \uXXXX に変換；Python 3.9 以降は --no-ensure-ascii；本ツールは既定でそのまま出力し、オンにすると ASCII だけになる。

statements.statement: 파싱과 포맷은 이 탭의 Web Worker에서 실행하며 JSON을 업로드하지 않는다；설정과 조건에 맞는 입력을 로컬 저장소에 저장；도구마다 JSON 직렬화 후 50KB, 초과하면 이전 상태 유지；200,000자 이상이면 설정만 저장；지우기나 Ctrl/⌘+L로 저장 입력 삭제；GA와 AdSense를 불러온다；format / minify는 성공 후에만 기록하고 중복 기록하지 않는다；입력 중·복원·오류·실패·취소·이전 결과는 기록하지 않는다；이벤트에는 도구 이름과 동작만 들어간다.

python3 -m json.tool은 기본적으로 출력 가능한 ASCII 밖의 문자를 \uXXXX로 쓴다；Python 3.9부터 --no-ensure-ascii；이 도구는 기본적으로 그대로 출력하고 옵션을 켜면 ASCII만 남는다.
